title: •Balanced Attack
caption: •Balanced Attack (V)
game_text: If your corvette, cruiser, and frigate are in battle together, cancel an opponent’s non-{sense} Interrupt. OR ▼ a frigate (deploys -2) to same system as your corvette and cruiser. OR ▼ a cruiser (deploys -3) to same system as your corvette and frigate.
lore: Alliance starfighter pilots cross-train with other starship types to maximize combat efficiency.

notes: Unique. Banner USED INTERRUPT. Inline red circle-slash S after 'non-' → {sense} (stub: 'non-(Immune to Sense)'); two ▼ where the stub expands them. Curly ’ in opponent’s. Lore matches the 350 px scan. Base scan only 350 px; copyright (SE 1998) not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1 -pre, 350 px); V24 'Balanced Attack & Darklighter Spin' is a different combo card, not downloaded.
